Worst service ever in Viet Nam
Jun 2024 • Friends
Myself ( white male) and my Viet wife took two of our friends ( both Viet) there for dinner, arrived, greeted ok, seated quickly, that's were it ended. Took forever to order, eventually we ordered a variety of starters and drinks, and ordered half Peking Dunk to share as a main. Drinks , one beer and Pepsis, arrived hot, with a glass with small ice. Starters were ok and tasty, then the duck arrived, a nice half roasted peking duck was presented, then disappeared, wrapped cold rolls with the duck skin were then served. After that we were expecting the rest of the duck ,chopped up and served with some brooth and the bones, fat, etc, basically the rest of the duck we paid for. Instead received a dish that I can only discribe as Baby food, looked like pork with instant noodles. Now back to the drinks, can't help but wonder why the table of five next to us, had a nice bowl of ice chilling their drinks, whilst us of four were brought hot beer and softdrinks, my empty glass and obvious empty beer can sat for 45 minutes with no acknowledgment, my first drink took 20 mins, after i had to get someone s attention. Luckily we had plenty to talk about to keep us busy. I could not see any other westerners in the place so can I assume the slow/ poor service was due to Myself being a Westerner. Past eight years I ve been to Sai Gon so many times, I ve lost count and honestly you get better service from a street side vendor than this place. Its a solid 0 stars.

Avoid unless you want to be cheated
Nov 2019 • Friends
Saw their 99,000 dong eat as much as you like offer from 8 to 10 am.
Arrived at 8.35 am and as there was five of us ordered one serve each from their limited menu of 14 items. After more than 15 minutes, the first item arrived. After a wait of another 15 minutes, the 2 nd and 3 rd item arrived but there was only one item per serve instead of the 3 or 4 per serve. Told them, we are not fools. By this time, surrounding tables also got upset as they were also treated similarly.
The table beside us started screaming at them as the kids on that table were really hungry and upset.
The other table beside us walked out. We then asked for the bill. After 20 minutes, still no bill. I proceeded to the cashier and in a loud voice demanded the bill.
After 10 minutes, they informed me there was no charge. Told them I would be posting
on Trip Advisor to warn others of their ethics. In all my years of posting, have never met a restaurant with such poor and questionable ethics.
Avoid at all costs
